sections.title: Unit 27: Healthcare in Hungary, 2010–2026
body: Between 2010 and 2026 Hungarian healthcare saw state takeover of hospitals, repeated debts to suppliers, a large pay rise for doctors, pay disputes with nurses, a new law on the Medical Chamber and a hospital building programme. Each step was judged differently by the government, professional bodies and critics.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: comparison, cause and result, time frames, open questions and concession. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
